entries.source: Arrows are used with bows to pierce your foes to death.
entries.target: 箭矢与弓配合使用，用来射穿敌人。

entries.source: Wound the target dealing #RED#%d#LAST# physical damage across 5 turns and reducing healing by %d%%
entries.target: 使目标流血，在5回合内造成#RED#%d#LAST#物理伤害，并降低目标治疗系数%d%%

entries.source: Cripple the target reducing mind, spell, and combat action speeds by 30%
entries.target: 致残目标，降低30%攻击、施法和精神速度

entries.source: Splash the target with acid dealing #VIOLET#%d#LAST# damage over 5 turns and reducing armor and accuracy by #VIOLET#%d#LAST#
entries.target: 用酸液溅射对方，在5回合内造成#VIOLET#%d#LAST#酸性伤害，并降低目标护甲和命中#VIOLET#%d#LAST#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#25%%#LAST# chance for lightning to strike from the target to a second target dealing #VIOLET#%d#LAST# damage
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#25%%#LAST#几率造成连锁闪电，从这个目标跳跃到另一个目标，造成#VIOLET#%d#LAST#伤害
引发元素爆炸，造成#VIOLET#%d#LAST#%s伤害（每回合最多一次）

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#20%%#LAST# chance to create an air burst in radius 3 knocking enemies back 2 spaces and dealing #RED#%d#LAST# physical damage
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#20%%#LAST#几率在半径3格范围内引发空气爆炸，击退敌人2格，并造成#RED#%d#LAST#物理伤害

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#20%%#LAST# chance to create vines that bind the target to the ground dealing #YELLOW#%d#LAST# nature damage and pinning them for 3 turns
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#20%%#LAST#几率产生藤蔓束缚目标并造成#YELLOW#%d#LAST#自然伤害，定身目标3回合。

entries.source: Deals #YELLOW#%d#LAST# Manaburn damage and puts 1 random spell talent on cooldown for #YELLOW#%d#LAST# turns (checks Confusion immunity)
entries.target: 造成#YELLOW#%d#LAST#法力燃烧伤害，并将1个随机法术技能置入冷却#YELLOW#%d#LAST#回合（须通过混乱免疫）

entries.source: #YELLOW#%s has their %s spell disrupted for for %d turns!
Cause the target to have a 10%% chance to fail spellcasting and 10%% chance to lose a magical sustain each turn, stacking up to 50%%
entries.target: 使目标每回合有10%%几率施放法术失败，并有10%%几率失去一项魔法持续技能，最高叠加到50%%
